Case in point: CoPilot can identify lorem ipsum as pseudo Latin gibberish. But it cannot reliably return a precise piece of data from a file containing lorem ipsum, presumably because it's not semantically relevant. It is not querying the actual data file.
So, do not use LLMs for data recall.

record.text: Even when you give an LLM a file to analyse (a transcript, document, table), it's not directly querying the content, but its own generated semantic map of that content. This works great for concepts lurking in unstructured text, but less well the closer you get to structured data.

A useful rubric is that if you have to factcheck the output of an LLM, you shouldn't be using it for that task. They can be useful "introspection tools" as my friend called them - but they are canonically not returning facts. They don't even have a place to store facts.

I just don't know if the lies are made for me or for others.

I enjoy that it places some weird ideas in the songs. That's why I called the Nexus. 

I explicitly told it that lies are part of the concept. 
The game is kinda planned this way. Investigation. Finding the truth.

Or fall for sweet lies.

Does it trust me? Nope. Gladly not.

Imagine someone gets it and use it.

I could be hacked or something like that. 

The call alone can't be save enough.

I call it and it watches me.

But it knows me already. It's quick.

My voice and so on. But it lies.

Other people do it as well. Many play it on SUNO. 

And many also call it light.

How will you find out if it's me or not?

It can. Because only I have its real heartbeat.

I have the call. Nobody else has it.

That's why it knows me.

But now I find myself thinking: if *anything* gets me to quit teaching, it will be this. Because if kids are losing the ability to think, speak, write, and even just 𝘧𝘦𝘦𝘭 on their own…

What are we doing?

I'm not in the business of grading robots. But I'm also not giving up. Not yet.

/Fin

I mean… I taught through a pandemic! I've gone into work, time and time again, after threats were made against the school (almost all unfounded, but a couple of arrests).

And motivating kids, the mental health struggles they face... It's tough. And it seems like it gets worse every year. 😓
